Class GreenhouseRadiativeEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier1.GreenhouseRadiativeEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class GreenhouseRadiativeEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Radiative Greenhouse Effect, Stefan-Boltzmann Equilibrium & Clausius-Clapeyron Dynamics Engine.

Strictly governed by physical atmospheric concentrations ($[\text{CO}_2]$, $[\text{CH}_4]$) and surface radiative physics (AGENTS.md Â§7.2, Â§10.1, Â§10.2), with zero dependency on synthetic avgTechLevel mitigation cliffs.

  • Method Details

    • computeRadiativeForcingWpm2

      public double computeRadiativeForcingWpm2()
      Calculates net radiative forcing in $\text{W/m}^2$ directly from physical atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$ and $\text{CH}_4$ concentrations (Myhre et al. 1998; IPCC AR6): $$\Delta F = 5.35 \ln\!\left(\frac{[\text{CO}_2]}{[\text{CO}_2]_0}\right) + 0.036\left(\sqrt{[\text{CH}_4]} - \sqrt{[\text{CH}_4]_0}\right)$$ Note: Negative anomalies ($[\text{CO}_2] invalid input: '<' 280\,\text{ppm}$, e.g. glacial LGM $185\,\text{ppm}$) produce authentic negative radiative forcing without artificial zero-clipping.
      Returns:
      radiative forcing anomaly in $\text{W/m}^2$
